name: loop-spec
description: Loop-driven development from a spec file or prose prompt for Codex. Semantic autonomous routing selects micro, bounded debug, or the full seven-phase cycle, then delivers a verified PR.

interface.longDescription: Give Codex a feature description or a pre-authored spec. loop-spec runs SPEC, DISCUSS, PLAN, EXECUTE, VERIFY, ITERATE, and DELIVER from one source tree shared with Claude Code, OpenCode, and Google ADK.
